ModMetaData.name: DefLoadCache
ModMetaData.author: FluxxField
ModMetaData.description:
Caches the result of RimWorld's mod XML loading and patching, so launches with an unchanged mod list skip that work.
WHAT IT DOES On startup, RimWorld reads every mod's XML files and applies every XML patch, from scratch, every launch. DefLoadCache saves the finished, patched result to disk. On the next launch with the same mod list, it loads that saved result instead of reading the files and running the patches again.
How much faster depends on how many mods you have, how many XML patches they use, and your disk speed. On a 414-mod list under RimWorld 1.6, cached launches went from about 9 minutes to about 2:40.
HOW IT WORKS - The cache is keyed to your exact mod list: load order, mod versions, every Defs/Patches/Assemblies file, and the RimWorld version. Any change rebuilds it automatically. - Each mod list profile keeps its own cache. - Before using a cache, the mod checks that the file is intact and that the def counts match. A bad cache is deleted and rebuilt, and the game loads normally. - Only startup loading is affected. Gameplay, defs and saves are unchanged, and you can add or remove the mod at any time. - Options > Mod Settings > DefLoadCache shows cache status and has buttons to clear the cache or launch once without it.
WHEN YOU WON'T SEE A SPEEDUP Any launch that has to build the cache runs at normal speed, or slightly slower, because the result is also saved to disk. That happens: - on the first launch after installing - after adding, removing or reordering mods - after any mod updates, including automatic Steam Workshop updates. On large mod lists this can be frequent. - after a RimWorld update The next launch with the same mod list uses the cache. The game log shows whether a launch used it (search Player.log for "DefLoadCache Status").
COMPATIBILITY - RimWorld 1.6. Requires Harmony. Prepatcher is no longer needed; you can keep it installed if other mods use it. RimWorld 1.7 support will return in a later update. - Works alongside texture/asset loading mods (such as Faster Game Loading) and runtime performance mods; they speed up different parts of the game. - Star Ring Corporation: works as of 1.3.1. Its mod list entry may still flag DefLoadCache as incompatible until its authors update it. - MissileGirl: turn off its XML cache (Gagarin) first. Both mods cache the same loading step. - Not compatible with Visual XML Patches (by Mlie): on cached launches patches aren't applied, so it has nothing to show. Disable DefLoadCache while you use it, or use "Test without cache" for one launch.
KNOWN LIMITATIONS - Mod settings are not tracked. If another mod's settings turn its XML patches on or off, use "Clear all cached data" in DefLoadCache's settings after changing them. - Mods that generate or change def XML from code during loading, instead of through normal Defs and Patches files, may not be reflected in the cache. - Only XML loading and patching are cached. Textures, sounds and def processing still load every launch. - If you are reporting a bug to another mod's author, reproduce it with "Test without cache" first.
